industry.ipm: Indian pharma market (IPM): +13.5% in Q1FY27 and +11.1% on MAT Jun-26 (IQVIA, via Kotak Neo); Pharmarack: Jun-2026 +13.3%, MAT +9.8%. Chronic therapies grew ~20% in Jun-2026 vs ~13% for acute. Obesity and diabetes (GLP-1s) are the fastest-growing segments. Cipla's prescription business grew 15.4% in the June quarter, 183bp ahead of the IPM (IQVIA).
industry.respiratory: Respiratory is ~a third of Cipla's revenue. In India Cipla holds 26.2% of the respiratory market (CARE) and all top-5 respiratory brands (Q4FY26 presentation); Foracort crossed Rs1,000 cr (MAT Jun-26 Rs1,069 cr, +15.7%), Duolin Rs660 cr, Budecort Rs578 cr (IQVIA via ICICI Direct). In the US Cipla is No.1 in albuterol MDIs (21% share, IQVIA week to 26-Jun-2026).
industry.usGenerics: US generics: price erosion in plain orals; value sits in complex products (inhalers, peptides, injectables) where few companies can make an approvable copy. Cipla's US share is 1.57% of generics, top-20 (AR FY26). Exclusivity windows are short: Advair already has three or four generic competitors; Ventolin has CGT exclusivity for six months.
industry.southAfrica: South African private market +5.7% (IQVIA MAT May-26); Cipla is No.2 in prescriptions (8.8% share) and No.3 overall (8.5%). Public tenders are price-driven: Cipla lost one in FY26 that hurts FY27.
industry.emeu: Emerging Markets & Europe: $405mn in FY26, direct-to-market (DTM) plus B2B; hit by the West Asia conflict in Q4FY26 ($90mn vs $103mn).
